fields.name: Hubble Deep Field North (1995)
fields.geometry_status: historical pointing centre; footprint not ingested
fields.relation: original HDF-N; distinct from GOODS-N and CDF-N

fields.name: Hubble Deep Field South (1998)
fields.geometry_status: historical pointing centre; footprint not ingested
fields.relation: original HDF-S in Tucana; not GOODS-S

fields.name: GOODS-S
fields.relation: parent field for HUDF/XDF and JADES GOODS-S
fields.geometry_status: centre marker only; footprint not ingested

fields.name: GOODS-N
fields.geometry_status: centre marker only; footprint not ingested

fields.name: HUDF / XDF
fields.relation: nested in GOODS-S; overlaps JADES GOODS-S observations
fields.geometry_status: approximate centre marker only; footprint not ingested

fields.name: JADES GOODS-S
fields.relation: survey region within GOODS-S, not a single pointing
fields.geometry_status: parent-region locator only; actual DR footprint pending

fields.name: JADES GOODS-N
fields.relation: survey region within GOODS-N, not a single pointing
fields.geometry_status: parent-region locator only; actual DR footprint pending

interaction.crossmatch: white highlight when same astrophysical object is present in >=2 enabled surveys
interaction.geometry: actual angular footprint; never decorative cone

notes: CDF-S overlaps major optical/IR deep-field work and is a priority crossmatch anchor.
Keep Chandra source detections distinct from optical/IR survey membership.
No-detection must remain distinct from not-surveyed-to-depth.
Field centres and parent-region locators are not authoritative angular footprints; overlapping markers must not imply identical coverage.
